blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Cebuano duathlete Franklin Ferdie Yee is set for another international test as he joins the Philippine National Duathlon Team in the Kuala Lumpur City Duathlon in Malaysia. Yee, along with fellow national team members Maynard Pecson, John Patrick Ciron, and Sam Corpuz, has already flown to Malaysia with duathlon coach Melvin Fausto as the Filipinos take on some of the region’s top duathletes. The Kuala Lumpur race marks Yee’s second international competition of the year following his campaign in the 2026 Asia Triathlon Duathlon Cup Tam Chuc in Vietnam on May 15.
